title: Limit of the sharp radius comparison
statement: For $0<\lambda<1/2$, let $\rho(q,\lambda)$ be the sharp discrete radius and let $C(\lambda)$ be the finite-product norm comparison constant as defined above. As $q$ tends to $2$ through values greater than $2$, $\exp\!\left(-\frac{q\log\rho(q,\lambda)}{q-2}\right)$ tends to $C(\lambda)$.
replaced: Let $0<\lambda<1/2$, define $r_q(\lambda)=\sqrt{\frac{\sinh(\log((1-\lambda)/\lambda)/q)}{\sinh(\log((1-\lambda)/\lambda)/(q/(q-1)))}}$, and put $C_\lambda=((1-\lambda)/\lambda)^{1/(2(1-2\lambda))}$. Then $\lim_{q\to2^+}\exp(-q\log r_q(\lambda)/(q-2))=C_\lambda$.
